protocol.name: new_bank_v2_cross_user_intensity_8ch
protocol.feature_contract: 200 ms nonoverlapping 8-channel 1000 Hz; F0v2 thresholds only from source no-motion; F2a centered fixed-0.05-shrinkage trace covariance; F3c circular-lag summaries and half-window drift
protocol.classifier: source-trial StandardScaler plus balanced LogisticRegression C=1 max_iter=2000 random_state=20260924
protocol.aggregation: mean of at most eight nonoverlapping native 200 ms windows per trial
protocol.selection: maximize pooled validation macro-F1, break ties by lower pooled validation log loss; final subjects cannot alter arm choice
protocol.scope: new eight-channel public-device zero-target-calibration cross-user intensity screen; instructed force/intensity, not measured mechanical force or own-device live recognition
